About me

Structure behind the scenes, so growth shows up out front.

Hi, I’m Petronilah, an Executive & Operations Virtual Assistant with a Bachelor of Commerce in Finance, working remotely from Nairobi and supporting founders and business owners.

I take care of the work that quietly eats a leader’s week: organized inboxes, calendars that run without you, travel, research and systems that don’t depend on your memory.

My finance background means I don’t just tidy your operations. I understand the numbers behind them. Every workflow I build protects your time and your bottom line.

Founders and CEOs needing inbox, calendar and follow-up handled with discretion.

Work samples

See it in action.

Bookkeeping & Financial Organization

The task

Keep a small business’s money records organized and up to date.

What I did

Categorized bank and mobile money transactions in QuickBooks Online, recorded expenses by category and raised an invoice, so the books show what came in, what went out and what is still owed.

Calendar Management

The task

Keep a busy client week free of conflicts, and lay out a full executive week at Gefyra.

What I did

Protected deep work blocks, spaced client calls with buffer time and honored school pick-ups. For Gefyra, scheduled team meetings, candidate interviews, focus blocks and buffer time day by day, with a meeting link on every call.

Inbox Management

The task

Turn a crowded inbox into a clear plan, then apply the same system to a working inbox.

What I did

Triaged and labeled emails as Action Required, Important Not Urgent and FYI, so every message has an owner and a next step.

Travel Planning & Coordination

The task

Plan an Abuja to Accra founder trip and a six-person Lagos to Accra team trip.

What I did

Compared flights and hotels, planned ground transport and built full trip budgets around meetings and a networking session.

Founder trip 19–21 Nov 2026 · NGN 1,415,464 incl. 10% contingencyTeam trip 30 Nov–2 Dec 2026 · NGN 4,752,402 · NGN 792,067 per person

Task & Project Management

The task

Plan a virtual talent webinar and keep a founder’s week organized.

What I did

Built a Trello board tagged by phase, with an owner, due date and priority on every task. Added an executive board with a Waiting/Follow-Up stage and a Notion daily dashboard with time blocks.

Research, Audit & Prioritization

The task

Shortlist candidates, audit a brand’s content and sort a busy Friday.

What I did

Compared Remote Executive Assistant applicants on experience, skills, fit and concerns. Reviewed 11 recent LinkedIn posts for topic, audience, CTA and engagement. Built a priority matrix with an immediate action for every task.

Candidate names and profiles are blurred for privacy.

Graphic Design in Canva

The task

Design an event flyer for the GEFYRA Talent Webinar, then rework it in a bolder layout.

What I did

Set the date, time and venue in a highlighted details card with a clear register button. The second version uses the brand gold, a team photo and a clear call to register.

How I work

Three steps. No guesswork.

1

Understand

I learn your priorities, your tools and what you want handled without asking.

2

Organize

I triage the inbox, clean up the calendar and put every follow-up into a tracker with an owner and a date.

3

Maintain

I run a daily brief and a weekly review, so the system keeps working without relying on memory.
